summary: Frontend-only test of /properties page map sidebar + card->pin highlight sync. All acceptance criteria pass at 1600x1000 viewport.

test_results.map_renders_with_3_markers_on_xl: PASS - .mapboxgl-canvas + 3 .mapboxgl-marker rendered; data-testid=property-map present; map-hint visible
test_results.card_hover_pin_highlight: PASS - Hovering chelsea card scaled marker[0] svg to scale(1.7) with gold drop-shadow rgba(212,175,55,0.95) 0 0 9px; other 2 remained scale(1)/none
test_results.highlight_moves_to_other_card: PASS - Hovering kensington card: marker[0] reset to scale(1), marker[1] scaled to 1.7 with gold glow (only one active at a time)
test_results.mouse_leave_clears_highlight: PASS - After moving mouse off grid, all 3 markers reset to scale(1)/filter none
test_results.filter_sync_updates_markers: PASS - Typing 'Beach' in location filter: cards=0, markers=0, results-count='0 RESULTS' (from '3 RESULTS')
test_results.results_count_correct: PASS - shows '3 RESULTS' baseline; '0 RESULTS' after non-matching filter
test_results.console_errors: PASS - Zero JS console errors / page errors. Only benign WebGL GPU-stall performance warnings from Mapbox driver.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Map sidebar only renders at xl (>=1280px). Use viewport >=1600 to be safe.
